title: Closed-section compact source for comparison-image coefficients
statement: Fix the finite-coefficient setting P, with coefficient ring A, of [def-pur-conventions]. Let B be separated finite type over k and let f:X→B be separated finite type with its standing compactification. Let s:B→X be a closed section (s followed by f is id_B), with quasi-compact open complement and exact pro-etale direct image. All bounded-below derived functors and composition and identity comparisons are those of [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] and [thm-sf-comp-composition]. Use the exact comparison ν* of [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Put Ue_T=A_T^et[0], Up_T=(ν_T* A_T^et)[0], Se=(s_*^et A_B^et)[0] and Sp=(s_*^pro ν_B*A_B^et)[0]. Let chi_T:ν_T*Ue_T≅Up_T be the exact-single comparison and let epsilon:ν_X*Se≅Sp be the exact-single comparison followed by the unique supported-constant comparison preserving constant restriction of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality]. Let origin_B be the explicitly retained etale-origin object ν_B*Ue_B [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Define Ie:Rs_!^et Ue_B≅Se by the proper comparison followed by the exact-derived-single comparison. Define Ip:Rs_!^pro origin_B≅Sp by Rs_!(chi_B), the proper comparison and the exact-derived-single comparison. Define Sigmae:Rf_!^et Se≅Ue_B as Rf_!(Ie inverse), followed by composition for s,f, transport along sf=id_B, and the etale identity comparison. Define Sigmap:Rf_!^pro Sp≅Up_B by Rf_!(Ip inverse), followed by the origin composition for s,f, transport along sf=id_B, origin identity comparison, and chi_B. These origin comparisons use [def-sf-origin-candidate-comparison]. Let beta:ν_B* Rf_!^et Se≅Rf_!^pro Sp be the D+ compatibility, inverse compact-support site comparison at Se from [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction], and Rf_!(epsilon), in that order. Then ν_B*(Sigmae.hom) followed by chi_B.hom equals beta.hom followed by Sigmap.hom. There is no Cartier map, target complex or target-map equality among the hypotheses or conclusions.

proof.text: Apply closed_section_compact_origin to the standing compactification of f. Its source equation uses standard pro-etale constants; let q_B be comparisonUpperStarUnitIso embedded in degree zero, and q_s its closed direct image. Naturality of proper and exact-derived comparison identifies its closed source isomorphism with Ip followed by q_s. Uniqueness of the supported comparison normalized at constant restriction identifies its supported comparison with epsilon followed by q_s. Its constant comparison is chi followed by q_B.

proof.text: Identify its etale source isomorphism with Sigmae by the identity law for the self candidate. Identify its pro-etale source isomorphism with Fp(q_s inverse), followed by Sigmap and q_B. Expand the origin compositor and cancel the self candidate comparison using fully faithful etale descent and the self comparison law. Substitute into the source equation, cancel Fp(q_s) with its inverse by functoriality, and cancel the isomorphism q_B. This is the stated equation.

theorem comparisonImage_closed_section_normalization (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B X : Scheme.{u}} (b : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated b] [LocallyOfFiniteType b] [QuasiCompact b]
    (f : X ⟶ B) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification f] (s : B ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    [QuasiCompact s.openComplement.ι]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) s)]
    [HasCompactification (s ≫ f)] (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 B) :
    (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (closedSectionSigmae P f s hs).hom) ≫
      (closedSectionChi P B).hom =
      (closedSectionBeta P f s).hom ≫ (closedSectionSigmap P f s hs).hom
